mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO property_source (source_code, source_name, base_url, is_enabled) VALUES (#{sourceCode}, #{sourceName}, #{baseUrl}, TRUE)
ON CONFLICT (source_code) DO UPDATE SET source_name = EXCLUDED.source_name, base_url = EXCLUDED.base_url
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE source_name = incoming.source_name, base_url = incoming.base_url
mapper.select: SELECT s.*, COUNT(p.id) AS listing_count FROM property_source s LEFT JOIN property_listing p ON p.source_id = s.id AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY s.id ORDER BY s.id
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO property_listing (source_id, source_listing_key, title, original_url, prefecture, city, address, rent_yen, management_fee_yen, layout, area_m2, station_name, walk_minutes, image_url, status, last_seen_at) VALUES (#{sourceId}, #{sourceListingKey}, #{title}, #{originalUrl}, #{prefecture}, #{city}, #{address}, #{rentYen}, #{managementFeeYen}, #{layout}, #{areaM2}, #{stationName}, #{walkMinutes}, #{imageUrl}, 'ACTIVE', #{lastSeenAt})
ON CONFLICT (source_id, source_listing_key) DO UPDATE SET title = EXCLUDED.title, original_url = EXCLUDED.original_url, prefecture = EXCLUDED.prefecture, city = EXCLUDED.city, address = EXCLUDED.address, rent_yen = EXCLUDED.rent_yen, management_fee_yen = EXCLUDED.management_fee_yen, layout = EXCLUDED.layout, area_m2 = EXCLUDED.area_m2, station_name = EXCLUDED.station_name, walk_minutes = EXCLUDED.walk_minutes, image_url = EXCLUDED.image_url, status = 'ACTIVE', last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at
AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE title = incoming.title, original_url = incoming.original_url, prefecture = incoming.prefecture, city = incoming.city, address = incoming.address, rent_yen = incoming.rent_yen, management_fee_yen = incoming.management_fee_yen, layout = incoming.layout, area_m2 = incoming.area_m2, station_name = incoming.station_name, walk_minutes = incoming.walk_minutes, image_url = incoming.image_url, status = 'ACTIVE', last_seen_at = incoming.last_seen_at
mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, s.source_name, s.source_code FROM property_listing p JOIN property_source s ON s.id = p.source_id WHERE p.status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.select: ORDER BY p.created_at DESC, p.id DESC LIMIT 6
